daily.summary: Intrusions at US federal and state systems lead the last 24 hours. FinCEN took systems offline after unauthorized access, an unclassified CIA and ODNI analysis system was breached, and Colorado's myColorado app remains down; none is attributed, though reporting links the CIA intrusion to the Chinese-made Artex AI platform. A suspected ransomware attack is disrupting care at Guadeloupe's university hospital. Palo Alto Networks patched an exploited kernel flaw used to root PAN-OS firewalls.

weekly.summary: AI-assisted intrusion remains the week's main theme. The FBI, the UK NCSC, Google, Unit 42, Amazon and GreyNoise describe agentic attack frameworks in real operations, and Bell Canada and the European Commission say AI-driven attackers breached them. Energy operators feature prominently: Norway reportedly links Equinor and Skagerak Energi incidents to an exploited Azure API Management flaw, KEPCO disclosed a large data breach and a US uranium mine was disrupted. State-linked activity includes China-nexus campaigns against vCenter and PAN-OS firewalls, Russian espionage against Romanian and US targets, and North Korean financial theft. Breaches at US federal and state systems, including the FBI's NCIC, FinCEN, a CIA/ODNI OSINT system, Colorado and West Virginia, remain unattributed.
